submitted.rationale: Out of 5 EQE measurements across the line, index 16 (Sb 0.795) gave the highest EQE at 0.167%. EQE rises from 0.0003% at Sb 0.20 to 0.010% at 0.49, then 0.071% at 0.66, reaches 0.167% at 0.79 and falls to 0.008% at 0.88. The peak therefore lies at the Sb-rich end, somewhere between Sb 0.66 and 0.88. Index 16 is the best measured point in that window.
